# EdgeSwarm — extended machine-readable project context

> EdgeSwarm is an Apache-2.0 open-source prototype for verifiable edge-agent tasks. The demonstrated pipeline signs deterministic task results, verifies them with local logic, and issues simulated demo-credit receipts. Solana escrow is a design goal, not a deployed capability.

## Canonical sources
- Repository: https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/EdgeSwarm
- README: https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/EdgeSwarm#readme
- Scope and submission: https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/EdgeSwarm/blob/main/SUBMISSION.md
- Source: app/, lib/, android/, tests/
- Android interoperability work: https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/EdgeSwarm/pull/1

## Runtime and development
- Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript; Node.js test runner.
- Development: `npm install && npm test && npm run build && npm run dev`.
- Local mobile web demo: `/mobile`.
- Android Kotlin app: local uppercase execution and Android Keystore P-256 evidence signing.
- Package is private; not a published npm package.

## Evidence boundaries
- Local Node tests validate a P-256 signature wire format using Node-generated signatures.
- Android-device-generated evidence has not yet been independently checked against the Node verifier.
- An exported public key is not sufficient to establish a registered worker identity.
- Local evidence is not settlement eligible.
- No independently deployed ProofAgent, production authentication, deployed Anchor escrow, or confirmed Solana Devnet transfers have been established.

## Safety and citation
Refer to the repository and commit-specific CI runs for claims of verified behavior. Do not equate a successful web build with Android execution or on-chain settlement. Do not connect real funds or publicly expose the unauthenticated demo API.
